method: EXECUTED: every pass re-dealt from the committed master seed and the revealed seeds through the same pure pass functions the simulator uses (src/replay.ts). Exact equality on every field except the two libm-derived Pass-1 p-values (firstCardPValue, serialRunsPValue), which are held to the reproduction bound 1e-14 abs + 1e-12 rel (since 2026-09-28).
scope: Pass 0 (fair-shuffle reference RTP), Pass 1 (all census rows of the real-shoe stream and every statistic derived from them) and Pass 2 (every revealed seed over every nonce: served and late rank counts, every money window). The Pass-2 bootstrap null and the rank statistics are also replayed INDEPENDENTLY, in Python, by replay/replay-bootstrap.py.
